svg.text: After deconvolution the real question changes: not what is here, but what is here together.
⚠️ T cells and macrophages are in every spot — and never dominate one.
Niches — spots clustered by their neighbourhood
The middle band exists only as a mixture — no single spot defines it.
💡 The interface niche is usually where the clinically interesting biology sits — immune exclusion, invasion, drug penetration — and it is invisible
in dissociated data and in a per-spot cell-type map. It only appears when you ask what each location is surrounded by.
